purpose: Translate the locked P03 Visual Master into a Rurubu-style story/timeline editorial page using the current V30 display-role, shared-component, ornament-family, fingerprint and true-alpha rules learned from P01/P02.

visualMaster.rule: Composition, hierarchy, photo count, asymmetry, local density and editorial character come from the Visual Master. Personal/story/Q&A copy visible in the image is reference-only unless separately approved.

liveFigma.rule: Treat P03 as a clean production build into the existing protected frame. Do not repurpose P01/P02 or create a duplicate P03 frame.

threeSecondReadOrder: ふたりのこれまで ribbon
Wedding Day card / bottom church-tropical cluster / PAGE 03
pageVisualLanguage.density: medium-high to high but directional; more narrative/information-dense than P02, less cover-like than P01
pageVisualLanguage.asymmetry: title-left / hero-right / timeline-left-heavy / Q&A-right-heavy; never normalize into equal columns
hardRejects: two mirrored Q cards with color swap only
ornaments becoming standalone art pieces stronger than the story/photos

GENERATED_DISPLAY_ASSET.rule: One high-saliency authored title asset. Keep adjacent airplane/flowers separate unless visually inseparable after full-page QA.
Coordinated with the title but independently placeable; exact locked editorial copy.
One coordinated family with five distinct authored members. Preserve semantic colors and local accents; do not clone one component five times.
Generated/composed paper vessel + Q3 badge only. Question/answer remain native until approved.
Generated/composed paper vessel + Q4 badge only. Related to Q3 but deliberately non-identical; question/answer remain native until approved.
May be composed as one display object because the canonical date is locked and separately recorded.

NATIVE_TEXT: intro sentence under the header until explicitly copy-locked
any autobiographical/personal statement not grounded outside the Visual Master

SHARED_PUBLICATION_COMPONENT.implementation: instance of PAGE_BADGE_SHARED_MASTER 3772:2 with Page Number=03
SHARED_PUBLICATION_COMPONENT.hardRule: Do not generate or redraw a page-specific PAGE 03 badge.

SHARED_PUBLICATION_COMPONENT.implementation: reuse the intentional V30 shared border system/source where compatible
SHARED_PUBLICATION_COMPONENT.rule: This is intentional shared publication furniture and is exempt from page-specific exact-source reuse rejection.

rules: All five use clean standalone proxies or approved real photos, never crops from the Visual Master/page screenshot.
Hero/photo frames and pink tape remain separate from photo fills.
Support photos intentionally vary tilt, scale and placement.
Step 5 intentionally has no photo inset.

reuse: Reuse V30 family grammar and approved shared components, not exact P01/P02 page-specific image bytes.
Before P03 design lock, run PAGE_SPECIFIC_ASSET_FINGERPRINT_PASS against P01/P02 major page-specific ornament hashes/sources where carry-over is possible.

batches.first: Calibrate OUR STORY + ふたりのこれまで as one header ecology.
batches.then: Produce title and ribbon as separate authored assets; produce local airplane/tropical accents as page-specific ornaments.
Produce five visibly related but non-cloned step-label members with pink/blue/yellow/green/pink semantic coding.
Produce a shorter pink Q3 vessel and a taller blue Q4 vessel; never mirrored clones.

batches.rule: Produce bottom church/tropical cluster and local camera/ring/palm/flower/route accents only after page hierarchy and negative space are known.

hardRejects: pre-generating a giant icon pack before layout context
reusing P01/P02 tropical/airplane/camera assets byte-for-byte for page-specific roles
baking personal story/Q&A copy into generated art
bundling the continuous timeline route into each timeline step asset

sharedAndIndependentStructure.pageBadge: Use existing shared master 3772:2 with page-number property 03.
sharedAndIndependentStructure.continuousRoute: One independently movable story navigation motif spanning steps; not five repeated route fragments.
sharedAndIndependentStructure.heroTape: Independent from Hero photo and frame.
sharedAndIndependentStructure.q3q4: Related display-paper family but independent/non-identical objects.
sharedAndIndependentStructure.bottomCluster: Independent from Wedding Day card and PAGE badge.

referenceOnly: 出会ってから、今日までのふたりのストーリー♡
copySafety.rule: Reference-only copy may be represented as native placeholder/reference text for layout but must not be baked into generated art or promoted to autobiographical fact.

trueAlpha.rule: Floating generated display/ornament assets must pass current true-alpha policy before Figma placement.
trueAlpha.fallback: If direct true alpha fails, generate against one safe flat matte, extract once, then alpha preflight. Checkerboard is prohibited.

executionPhases: P0: read current authority, inspect blank P03 and shared components, freeze scope
P1: build warm paper/background + shared airmail border + PAGE_BADGE_SHARED_MASTER instance 03
P2: create five replaceable photo slots/frames and clean standalone proxies
P3: calibrate/produce header display family and local header ornaments
P4: calibrate/produce five timeline step-label displays + one continuous route + four support-photo relationships
P5: calibrate/produce non-identical Q3/Q4 paper displays while keeping question/answer native
P6: produce Wedding Day card, bottom church/tropical cluster and only needed micro ornaments
P7: one full-page screenshot QA, targeted local fixes only, live-role/shared-component/fingerprint/alpha/reference-delta checks, Drive/Git/PR sync, STOP
